notes_for_editor: Do not mix with the other Steamboat Peak lookout in Shoshone County (FFLA list coordinates 47.72346, -116.20595, Tower Gone), which is a different structure. A search snippet for that other lookout (idahofirelookouts.com/cda-region/steamboat-peak-lookout/) gives a 1930 camp and a 1934 40-foot pole L-4 tower destroyed in the 1950s; that page was not read in full and is not used here. The 1925 station may or may not be the site of the 1931 tower; the sources do not say, so the story only reports the item. The record's 3.7 m height matches 12 feet. No photo found, no staffing history beyond the 1925 item, and nothing on the site today.
